concept: Auto Scaling: lifecycle hooks and scale-in protection
tests: How to avoid interrupting long-running batch jobs on instances during scale-in.
expected: Lifecycle hooks (Terminating:Wait) and/or instance scale-in protection — the instance finishes its work before termination. Triggers: "avoid terminating instances still processing", "long-running jobs", "scale-in".
why_not: Desired capacity does not choose which instance to kill; cooldown 0 increases churn; detaching from the LB does not control termination.
